description.label: Description
description.value:
Minor Mental Mutation

You know that they are out to get you. They are working against you in numerous ways; spying on you, sabotaging your career, stealing your trappings, turning people against you and possibly even plotting to kill you. Consult the table below, or decide a suitable Target for your suspicion together with the GM. You gain @Fear[1] towards your Target, @UUID[Compendium.wfrp4e-core.items.Item.klCJX0mNpXYH5AIx]{Prejudice} (Target) and the @UUID[Compendium.wfrp4e-core.items.Item.AcnFuDKRemLI9ey7]{Nose for Trouble} Talent. If you gain this mutation again, you gain an additional Target.
